assumptions.closed_if: facility's own flood pixel is flooded
assumptions.loses_access: within the limit normally, beyond it during the flood
assumptions.year_losses: a year's map combines all of that year's floods, so access losses are an upper bound
assumptions.events: event maps compare the lowest radar backscatter in each event window with the January-March dry season; water that also appears in at least 4 of the other 6 Sentinel-1 years (normal monsoon water: haors, beels, floodplain) is removed, so events show water beyond the usual monsoon extent. surface_water_km2 is the area before that step
assumptions.years: yearly maps keep all flood water, including normal monsoon inundation, so the haor basin counts as flooded almost every year
assumptions.wading: everyone in a flooded cell is assumed to move at about 1.5 km/h; boats, raised roads and bridges are not modelled, so access losses are a stress test, not a count of people cut off
assumptions.eras: 2000-2018 MODIS (Global Flood Database, mapped events only) and 2019-2025 Sentinel-1 radar differ in resolution and detection; compare within an era
